data.topic: 句子 · Key Sentences (Textbook: 我要去换钱)

items.py: Zhèr néng bu néng huàn qián?

items.zh: 大卫：请问，这儿可以换钱吗？
items.py: Dàwèi: Qǐngwèn, zhèr kěyǐ huàn qián ma?
items.en: David: Excuse me, can I exchange money here?

items.py: Zhíyuán: Kěyǐ. Nín yào huàn shénme?
items.en: Staff: Yes. What do you want to exchange?
David: I want to exchange for RMB.

items.zh: 大卫：五百美元。今天的汇率是多少？
items.py: Dàwèi: Wǔbǎi měiyuán. Jīntiān de huìlǜ shì duōshao?
items.en: David: 500 US dollars. What's today's exchange rate?

items.zh: 职员：一美元换七块二。请先填一下这张表。
items.py: Zhíyuán: Yī měiyuán huàn qī kuài èr. Qǐng xiān tián yīxià zhè zhāng biǎo.
items.en: Staff: One dollar exchanges for 7.20 yuan. Please fill in this form first.

items.py: Dàwèi: Hǎo de. Tián hǎo le.

items.zh: 职员：这是三千六百块。请你数一数。
items.py: Zhíyuán: Zhè shì sānqiān liùbǎi kuài. Qǐng nǐ shǔ yi shǔ.
items.en: Staff: Here is 3,600 yuan. Please count it.

items.zh: 玛丽：大卫，你换了人民币没有？
items.py: Mǎlì: Dàwèi, nǐ huàn le rénmínbì méiyǒu?
items.en: Mary: David, have you exchanged RMB?

items.py: Mǎlì: Nǐ zài nǎr huàn de?
items.en: Mary: Where did you exchange it?

items.py: Dàwèi: Zài Zhōngguó Yínháng huàn de.
items.en: David: At the Bank of China.

items.zh: 玛丽：我也想去换。你去了几次？
items.py: Mǎlì: Wǒ yě xiǎng qù huàn. Nǐ qù le jǐ cì?
items.en: Mary: I also want to go exchange. How many times have you been?

items.zh: 大卫：我去了一次。你还没有换呢？
items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ qù le yī cì. Nǐ hái méiyǒu huàn ne?
items.en: David: I went once. You haven't exchanged yet?

items.zh: 玛丽：还没有呢。我明天去。
items.py: Mǎlì: Hái méiyǒu ne. Wǒ míngtiān qù.
items.en: Mary: Not yet. I'll go tomorrow.

items.zh: 大卫：银行离学校不太远，坐公共汽车三站就到了。
items.py: Dàwèi: Yínháng lí xuéxiào bú tài yuǎn, zuò gōnggòng qìchē sān zhàn jiù dào le.
items.en: David: The bank isn't too far from school, just three stops by bus.

data.topic: 会话3 · Dialogue 3 (Textbook: At the Hotel)

items.zh: 玛丽：钱都花了，我没钱了。我要去换钱。
items.py: Mǎlì: Qián dōu huā le, wǒ méi qián le. Wǒ yào qù huàn qián.
items.en: Mary: The money is all spent, I have no money. I'm going to change money.

items.zh: 大卫：听说饭店里可以换钱。
items.py: Dàwèi: Tīngshuō fàndiàn lǐ kěyǐ huàn qián.
items.en: David: I heard you can change money at the hotel.

items.zh: 玛丽：请问，这儿能不能换钱？
items.py: Mǎlì: Qǐngwèn, zhèr néng bu néng huàn qián?
items.en: Mary: Excuse me, can I change money here?

items.zh: 营业员：能。您带的什么钱？
items.py: Yíngyèyuán: Néng. Nín dài de shénme qián?
items.en: Clerk: Yes. What currency do you have?
Clerk: How much do you want to exchange?

items.zh: 玛丽：五百美元。一美元换多少人民币？
items.py: Mǎlì: Wǔbǎi měiyuán. Yī měiyuán huàn duōshao rénmínbì?
items.en: Mary: Five hundred dollars. How much RMB for one dollar?

items.zh: 营业员：六块一毛九。请您在这儿写一下儿钱数，在这儿写一下儿名字。
items.py: Yíngyèyuán: Liù kuài yī máo jiǔ. Qǐng nín zài zhèr xiě yíxiàr qiánshù, zài zhèr xiě yíxiàr míngzi.
items.en: Clerk: 6.19 yuan. Please write the amount here, and your name here.

items.py: Mǎlì: Zhèyàng xiě, duì bu duì?
items.en: Mary: Is it correct to write it like this?

items.zh: 营业员：对。给您钱，请数一数。
items.py: Yíngyèyuán: Duì. Gěi nín qián, qǐng shǔ yi shǔ.
items.en: Clerk: Correct. Here's your money, please count it.

items.zh: 大卫：时间不早了，我们快走吧！
items.py: Dàwèi: Shíjiān bù zǎo le, wǒmen kuài zǒu ba!
items.en: David: It's getting late, let's go!

items.py: Tā shì zài Běijīng xué de Hànyǔ.
Tā shì zuò fēijī lái de.
Wǒ shì qùnián lái Zhōngguó de.
items.en: I came to China last year.

items.en: count it → have a look (verb reduplication with 一)

items.zh: 今天的汇率比昨天好一点儿。
items.py: Jīntiān de huìlǜ bǐ zuótiān hǎo yīdiǎnr.
items.en: Today's exchange rate is a bit better than yesterday's.

items.py: Qǐngwèn yínháng jǐ diǎn kāi mén?
items.en: What time does the bank open?

items.zh: 银行九点开门，五点关门。
items.py: Yínháng jiǔ diǎn kāi mén, wǔ diǎn guān mén.
items.en: The bank opens at 9 and closes at 5.

items.zh: 你换了人民币没有？——换了。
items.py: Nǐ huàn le rénmínbì méiyǒu? —— Huàn le.

items.zh: 你吃了饭没有？——还没有呢。
items.py: Nǐ chī le fàn méiyǒu? —— Hái méiyǒu ne.
Tā mǎi le shū méiyǒu? —— Mǎi le.
items.en: Has he bought the book? — Yes.

items.py: Nǐ kàn le nàge diànyǐng méiyǒu?

items.zh: 你在哪儿换的？——在银行换的。
items.py: Nǐ zài nǎr huàn de? —— Zài yínháng huàn de.
items.en: Where did you exchange it? — At the bank.

items.zh: 你在哪儿买的？——在商店买的。
items.py: Nǐ zài nǎr mǎi de? —— Zài shāngdiàn mǎi de.
items.en: Where did you buy it? — At the shop.

items.zh: 你是什么时候来的？——昨天来的。
items.py: Nǐ shì shénme shíhou lái de? —— Zuótiān lái de.

items.zh: 他是怎么去的？——坐飞机去的。
items.py: Tā shì zěnme qù de? —— Zuò fēijī qù de.
items.en: How did he go? — By plane.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (Textbook: 语气助词「了」(2))

items.zh: 语气助词「了」表示某件事或某种情况已经发生。
items.py: Yǔqì zhùcí 'le' biǎoshì mǒu jiàn shì huò mǒu zhǒng qíngkuàng yǐjīng fāshēng.
items.en: The modal particle 了(le) indicates that an event or situation has already occurred.

items.zh: 你去哪儿？→ 你去哪儿了？
items.py: Nǐ qù nǎr? → Nǐ qù nǎr le?
items.en: Where are you going? → Where did you go? (了 marks completed action)

items.zh: 我去商店。→ 我去商店了。
items.py: Wǒ qù shāngdiàn. → Wǒ qù shāngdiàn le.
items.en: I'm going to the store. → I went to the store.

items.zh: 你买什么？→ 你买什么了？
items.py: Nǐ mǎi shénme? → Nǐ mǎi shénme le?
items.en: What do you buy? → What did you buy?

items.zh: 我买苹果。→ 我买苹果了。
items.py: Wǒ mǎi píngguǒ. → Wǒ mǎi píngguǒ le.
items.en: I buy apples. → I bought apples.

items.zh: 否定形式：他没去商店。（没 + V，去掉「了」）
items.py: Fǒudìng xíngshì: Tā méi qù shāngdiàn. (méi + V, qùdiào "le")
items.en: Negative: He didn't go to the store. (没 + V, drop 了)

items.zh: 正反问：你吃饭了没有？/ 你吃没吃饭？
items.py: Zhèngfǎn wèn: Nǐ chī fàn le méiyǒu? / Nǐ chī méi chī fàn?
items.en: A-not-A question: Have you eaten? (two forms)

data.topic: 练习 · Exercises (Textbook: 我要去换钱)

items.zh: 改错：昨天我没给你发短信了。→ 昨天我没给你发短信。
items.py: Gǎi cuò: Zuótiān wǒ méi gěi nǐ fā duǎnxìn le. → Zuótiān wǒ méi gěi nǐ fā duǎnxìn.
items.en: Correction: 没 negative does not use 了

items.zh: 改错：他常常去食堂吃饭了。→ 他常常去食堂吃饭。
items.py: Gǎi cuò: Tā chángcháng qù shítáng chī fàn le. → Tā chángcháng qù shítáng chī fàn.
items.en: Correction: habitual actions do not use 了

items.zh: 改错：昨天的生词很多了。→ 昨天的生词很多。
items.py: Gǎi cuò: Zuótiān de shēngcí hěn duō le. → Zuótiān de shēngcí hěn duō.
items.en: Correction: stating a past fact does not use 了

items.zh: 改错：昨天我不去商店。→ 昨天我没去商店。
items.py: Gǎi cuò: Zuótiān wǒ bú qù shāngdiàn. → Zuótiān wǒ méi qù shāngdiàn.
items.en: Correction: negating a past action uses 没, not 不

items.zh: 听说那个电影很好，我们去看看吧。
items.py: Tīngshuō nàge diànyǐng hěn hǎo, wǒmen qù kànkan ba.
items.en: I hear that movie is great, let's go see it.

items.zh: 现在我在上课，请你明天再来吧。
items.py: Xiànzài wǒ zài shàng kè, qǐng nǐ míngtiān zài lái ba.
items.en: I'm in class now, please come again tomorrow.

items.zh: A：你去哪儿了？ B：我去朋友家了。
items.py: A: Nǐ qù nǎr le? B: Wǒ qù péngyou jiā le.
items.en: A: Where did you go? B: I went to a friend's house.

items.zh: 好。你等一下儿，我去换件衣服。
items.py: Hǎo. Nǐ děng yíxiàr, wǒ qù huàn jiàn yīfu.
items.en: OK. Wait a moment, I'll go change clothes.
